deadquote/mw00: "Humanity is an ocean. If a few drops of the ocean are dirty, the ocean does not become dirty." - Mahatma Gandhi
deadquote/mw01:
"There is an international disease which feeds on the notion that you can use any means to further your cause, since the end justifies the means." 
- Richard Nixon
deadquote/mw02: "The world will not be destroyed by those who do evil, but by those who watch them without doing anything." - Albert Einstein
deadquote/mw03: "Nothing can, nothing will justify the murder of innocent people and helpless children." - Elie Wiesel, Nobel Laureate, Holocaust survivor
deadquote/mw04: "You never know how strong you are until being strong is your only choice" - Bob Marley
deadquote/mw05:
"We will bankrupt ourselves in the vain search for absolute security." 
- Dwight D. Eisenhower
deadquote/mw06: "As long as people believe in absurdities, they will continue to commit atrocities." - Voltaire, philosopher
deadquote/mw07: "The healthy man does not torture others." - Carl Gustav Jung, psychiatrist
deadquote/mw08:
"When you reach the end of your rope, tie a knot in it and hang on."
- Franklin D. Roosevelt
deadquote/mw09:
"It is during our darkest moments that we must focus to see the light."
- Aristotle
deadquote/mw10: "The greatest glory in living lies not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall." - Nelson Mandela
deadquote/mw11: "Success is not final, failure is not fatal. It is the courage to continue that counts." - Winston Spencer-Churchill
deadquote/mw12: "Out of suffering have emerged the strongest souls." - Khalil Gibran, poet
deadquote/mw13: "I have learned over the years that when one's mind is made up, this diminishes fear." - Rosa Parks
deadquote/mw14: "I alone cannot change the world, but I can cast a stone across the water to create many ripples." - Mother Teresa
deadquote/mw15: "The only person you are destined to become is the person you decide to be." - Ralph Waldo Emerson
deadquote/mw16: "How wonderful it is that nobody need wait a single moment before starting to improve the world." - Anne Frank
deadquote/mw17: "Do not pray for an easy life, pray for the strength to endure a difficult one." - Bruce Lee
deadquote/mw18: "It was my duty to shoot the enemy, and I don't regret it. My regrets are for the people I couldn't save." - Chris Kyle, Navy SEAL, sniper
deadquote/mw19: "I am not only a pacifist but a militant pacifist. I am willing to fight for peace." - Albert Einstein
deadquote/mw20: "There is a certain enthusiasm in liberty, that makes human nature rise above itself, in acts of bravery and heroism." - Alexander Hamilton
deadquote/mw21: "When the sword is once drawn, the passions of men observe no bounds of moderation." - Alexander Hamilton
deadquote/mw22:
"Whatever possession we gain by our sword cannot be sure or lasting." 
- Alexander the Great
deadquote/mw23: "If the highest aim of a captain were to preserve his ship, he would keep it in port forever." - Thomas Aquinas
deadquote/mw24: "Bravery is the capacity to perform properly even when scared half to death." - Omar N. Bradley, U.S Army General
deadquote/mw25: "The true soldier fights not because he hates what is in front of him, but because he loves what is behind him." - G.K. Chesterton, philosopher
deadquote/mw26: "Victory is reserved for those who are willing to pay its price." - Sun Tzu
deadquote/mw27:
"It is the cause, not the death, that makes the martyr."
- Napoleon Bonaparte
deadquote/mw28: "It's always best to stay out of other people's divorces. And their civil wars." - Gore Vidal
deadquote/mw29:
"Never fear your enemy, but always respect them."
- John Basilone, Medal of Honor Winner, WWII
deadquote/mw30:
"We live in a world of nuclear giants and ethical infants, in a world that has achieved brilliance without wisdom, power without conscience."
- Omar N. Bradley, U.S. Army General
deadquote/mw31:
"I could tell by the look on his face, he knew he was dead..."
- John "Mac" McAleese, SAS
deadquote/mw32: "If I charge, follow me. If I retreat, kill me. If I die, revenge me." - USMC
deadquote/mw33: "The battlefield is a scene of constant chaos. The winner will be the one who controls that chaos." - Napoleon Bonaparte
deadquote/mw34: "How glorious fall the valiant, sword in hand, in front of battle for their native land!" - King Agesilaus, Sparta
deadquote/mw35: "I abhor unjust war. I abhor injustice and bullying by the strong at the expense of the weak." - Theodore Roosevelt
deadquote/mw36:
"In time of war, the first casualty is truth."
- Boake Carter, radio commentator
deadquote/mw37: "I have been apt to think that there has never been, nor ever will be, any such thing as a good war, or a bad peace." - Benjamin Franklin
deadquote/mw38:
"War is only a cowardly escape from the problems of peace."
- Thomas Mann
deadquote/mw39:
"When the rich wage war, it's the poor who die."
- Jean-Paul Sartre
deadquote/mw40:
"Al-Qatala plans attacks to show al-haqiqa, 'truth.' We don't kill in the dark and throw the body in the sea. We show our war to the world."
- Omar Sulaman, The Wolf
deadquote/mw41: "There is no oath for a real warrior. I don't care what you say... I only care what you do." - Omar Sulaman, The Wolf
deadquote/mw42: "To fight without sorrow, to wage war without sympathy... This is the only way to become a true soldier." - Omar Sulaman, The Wolf
deadquote/mw43: "The Western world believes that we are for sale. They are wrong. The superpower is for sale. We are the buyers... - Omar Sulaman, The Wolf
deadquote/mw44: "We will never be captive to foreign power." - Omar Sulaman, The Wolf
deadquote/mw45:
"We are freedom fighters. We will not build lives without our freedom."
- Farah Karim
deadquote/mw46: "The gas kills all things, even food in our gardens. If you use these tactics, you are my enemy" - Farah Karim
deadquote/mw47: "I make no distinction between Al-Qatala and the Russian Army. They're both terrorists." - Farah Karim
deadquote/mw48: "This occupation must end. That we can all agree on." - Farah Karim
deadquote/mw49: "The invaders of my country have no regard for human life." - Farah Karim
deadquote/mw50: "I lead Soldiers. Al-Qatala trains killers." - Farah Karim
deadquote/mw51:
"I don't cross borders and invade. I defend my people here at home."
- Farah Karim
deadquote/mw52:
"Yes. There are extremists in our ranks, just as there are in yours..."
- Hadir Karim
deadquote/mw53: "If the war ended today, we would push these agitators out of the country and move forward into the modern world." - Hadir Karim
deadquote/mw54: "The longer we fight, the longer we live in chaos. When there is chaos, there is terror." - Hadir Karim
deadquote/mw55: "The new generation does not want violence. We did not start these wars, but we will do what we must to end them..." - Hadir Karim
deadquote/mw56:
"A terrorist attack cannot possibly destroy our country's way of life; it's only our reaction to that attack that can do that kind of damage."
- Bruce Schneier
deadquote/mw57: "The big threat to America is the way we react to terrorism by throwing away what everybody values about our country - a commitment to human rights." - Robert F. Kennedy
deadquote/mw58:
"Terrorism is the war of the poor, and war is the terrorism of the rich."
- Sir Peter Alexander Ustinov
deadquote/mw59:
"'Terrorism' is what we call the violence of the weak, and we condemn it; 'war' is what we call the violence of the strong, and we glorify it."
- Sydney J. Harris
deadquote/mw60:
"One man's terrorist is another man's freedom fighter."
- American Academy of Political and Social Science
deadquote/mw61: "No countries are less prepared to deal with terrorism than Western democracies." - Winston Spencer-Churchill
deadquote/mw62: "No country in the world is less fit for a conflict with terrorists than Great Britain. That is not because of her weakness or cowardice; it is because of her restraint and virtues." - Winston Spencer-Churchill
deadquote/mw63: Al-Qatala is headed by Omar Sulaman. Sulaman is a former freedom fighter, spending his youth fighting Russian occupation in Afghanistan.
deadquote/mw64: Omar Sulaman remobilized his freedom fighters against both Russia and the West. He called those new fighters,"Al-Qatala."
deadquote/mw65: Omar Sulaman's independence from foreign influence earned him the nickname, Al-dhiyb, or "The Wolf".
deadquote/mw66: Al-Qatala is a group of radical criminal anarchists who operate without regard for nation of origin or religion.
deadquote/mw67: AQ believes that organized government should be overthrown by force, violence, or by assassination.
deadquote/mw68: Al-Qatala strikes are designed to pull world powers into an untenable fight and destabilize the global economy.
deadquote/mw69: The Wolf encourages followers to exploit the First World's characteristic weaknesses through fear of death.
deadquote/mw70: AQ rejects religiosity and structure, favoring anarchy over institution.
deadquote/mw71: AQ is against all powers who perpetuate the proxy wars that have crippled the Mid-East region.
deadquote/mw72: Proxy War - noun, 1. a war instigated by a major power which does not itself become involved.
deadquote/mw73: "No one really knows why they are alive until they know what they'd die for." - Martin Luther King Jr.
deadquote/mw74: "When in a fight to the death, one wants to employ all one's weapons to the utmost." - Miyamoto Musashi
deadquote/mw75: "I guess the only time most people think about injustice is when it happens to them." - Charles Bukowski
deadquote/mw76: "Each time a man stands up for an ideal, or acts to improve the lot of others, or strikes out against injustice, he sends forth a tiny ripple of hope." - Robert F. Kennedy
deadquote/mw77: "Do not make the mistake of thinking that you have to agree with people and their beliefs to defend them from injustice." - Bryant McGill
deadquote/mw78: "Better to live in a rugged land and rule than to cultivate rich plains and be a slave." - Cyrus the Great
deadquote/mw79: "Your enemy is not the refugee. Your enemy is the one who made him a refugee." - Tariq Ramadan
deadquote/mw80: General Roman Barkov's Army invaded Urzikstan in 1999 to control what he calls "A breeding ground for terrorists..."
deadquote/mw81: General Barkov weaponized chlorine gas to control the "uncooperative" population of Urzikstan.
deadquote/mw82: General Barkov imprisoned most of the female population of Urzikstan to prevent "the birth of more terrorists..."
deadquote/mw83: The location of General Barkov's gas factory has never been verified by Western Intelligence.
deadquote/mw84: General Roman Barkov's mission in Urzikstan is to prevent terrorists from moving into Russia.
deadquote/mw85: "A successful man is one who can lay a firm foundation with the bricks others have thrown at him." - David Brinkley
deadquote/mw86: "The only reason a warrior is alive is to fight, and the only reason a warrior fights is to win." - Miyamoto Musashi
deadquote/mw87: "Victorious warriors win first and then go to war, while defeated warriors go to war first and then seek to win." - Sun Tzu
deadquote/mw88:
"It is not enough to win a war; it is more important to organize the peace."
- Aristotle
deadquote/mw89:
"Let no man surrender so long as he is unwounded and can fight."
- Bernard Law Montgomery
deadquote/mw90: "The art of war is simple enough. Find out where your enemy is. Get at him as soon as you can." - Ulysses S. Grant
deadquote/mw91:
"Terrorism must be outlawed by all civilized nations, not explained or rationalized, but fought and eradicated."
- Elie Wiesel
deadquote/mw92:
"...squalid warfare with terrorists should be avoided, and if ever it breaks out, every effort should be made to bring it to an end."
- Winston Spencer-Churchill
deadquote/mw93: Al-Qatala welcomes any and all warriors seeking to fight foreign power, oppression and resource theft.
deadquote/mw94: AQ deploys unconventional strategies and tactics that stand outside the laws of war.
deadquote/mw95: "Cowards die many times before their deaths. The valiant never taste of death but once." - William Shakespeare
deadquote/mw96: "...soon we shall either kill the barbarians or else we are bound to be killed ourselves." - King Leonidas, Sparta
deadquote/mw97:
"I must say that to die with one's sword still sheathed is most regrettable."
- Miyamoto Musashi
deadquote/mw98:
"Injustice anywhere is a threat to justice everywhere."
- Martin Luther King Jr.
deadquote/mw99:
"If everybody always lies to you, the consequence is not that you believe the lies, but that nobody believes in anything any longer."
- Hannah Arendt
deadquote/s4arth01:
"One needs an utter disregard for the imminent possibility of failure."
– Arthur Kingsley
deadquote/s4arth02:
"The odds weren’t with us, but they never are.
The job had to be done anyway."
– Arthur Kingsley
deadquote/s4arth03:
"I didn’t care if the mission was impossible.
I cared that it was necessary."
– Arthur Kingsley
deadquote/s4arth04:
"We could do what an army couldn’t:
move fast, strike hard, and get out alive."
– Arthur Kingsley
deadquote/s4arth05:
"No matter how much the day descended into chaos,
Arthur Kingsley convinced us we could rise above it."
– Richard Webb
deadquote/s4arth06:
"To run headlong towards darkness and fight in the shadows
requires courage. You have to do what you are afraid to do."
– Arthur Kingsley
deadquote/s4arth07:
"The hardest part is keeping it all inside. We don’t talk about
how we feel because so much depends on what we do."
– Arthur Kingsley
deadquote/s4arth08:
"No one can tell me what to do. But I'd follow Arthur
Kingsley to the ends of the earth if he asked me."
– Wade Jackson
deadquote/s4arth09:
"A good leader does not govern with
an iron will, but with an open heart."
– Arthur Kingsley
deadquote/s4arth10:
"The greatest strength one can have is the will to carry on."
– Arthur Kingsley
deadquote/s4arth11:
"I believed I could make the world a kinder place,
even just a little. But I couldn't do it alone."
– Arthur Kingsley
deadquote/s4arth12:
"There were many things I didn't know. But those people,
my team, I knew I trusted them. That was enough."
– Arthur Kingsley
deadquote/s4arth13:
"How do you stand up against such implacable hatred?
You stand together."
– Arthur Kingsley
deadquote/s4arth14:
"This cause, this team, and its fight for justice?
It had my whole heart."
– Arthur Kingsley
deadquote/s4arth15:
"Sadness, injustice, hope, fury. It's all
fuel on the fire of doing what is right."
– Arthur Kingsley
deadquote/s4arth16:
"Leaders are not born. They are honed in sorrow,
grief, and rage, and tempered by determination."
– Arthur Kingsley
deadquote/s4arth17:
"Fire is destruction and rage. But it's also hope and rebirth.
We're all carrying the fire. We're all learning to wield it."
– Arthur Kingsley
deadquote/s4arth18:
"Vengeance may be a strong motivator, but it's hope that fuels action."
– Arthur Kingsley
deadquote/s4arth19:
"One of the hardest parts of learning to lead is you
never just fail yourself anymore. You fail everyone."
– Arthur Kingsley
deadquote/s4arth20:
"The most serious failure of leadership is the failure to foresee."
– Arthur Kingsley
deadquote/s4luca01:
"Nothing gets the Jerrys’ attention like a proper explosion."
– Lucas Riggs
deadquote/s4luca02:
"If the war wasn't always interrupting us,
I reckon I'd win more at cards."
– Lucas Riggs
deadquote/s4luca03:
"Sometimes I think about the farm I grew up on. I don't
miss the farm much, but I do miss the sheep."
– Lucas Riggs
deadquote/s4luca04:
"Ever since I was a boy, I knew I wanted
to kick down doors and blow things up."
– Lucas Riggs
deadquote/s4luca05:
"An explosive personality can get you far in life.
Just remember the length of your fuse."
– Lucas Riggs
deadquote/s4luca06:
"Throw everything you've got at your problems:
your head, your heart, your grenades..."
– Lucas Riggs
deadquote/s4luca07:
"I don't know you can be 'lucky' in war. But with the teams I've been
on and the mates I've fought beside, I'd consider myself just that."
– Lucas Riggs
deadquote/s4luca08:
"I've never been lucky with leaders - always seemed
to get stuck with the worst types. Except for one."
– Lucas Riggs
deadquote/s4luca09:
"Think of a grenade like a ball in a game
of catch: always throw it back."
– Lucas Riggs
deadquote/s4luca10:
"Tough to imagine a better world when
the one we were in was so damn loud."
– Lucas Riggs
deadquote/s4luca11:
"Lucas Riggs never found a problem that
couldn’t be solved with an explosion."
– Wade Jackson
deadquote/s4luca12:
"I used to hate lamingtons. I assumed the worst about
them until I finally tasted one. Now I love them! I reckon
there's a lesson in there somewhere. Or not."
– Lucas Riggs
deadquote/s4luca13:
"So much happened to me in the war. So many stories,
good and bad. I always hoped to tell them someday."
– Lucas Riggs
deadquote/s4luca14:
"Lucas Riggs is loud, but efficient. I respect that."
– Polina Petrova
deadquote/s4luca15:
"Trust is a funny thing. I boiled it down to 'trust your friends and
not the dickheads.' You figure out which is which pretty quick." 
– Lucas Riggs
deadquote/s4luca16:
"If nothing else, fight for the people who can't fight for themselves."
– Lucas Riggs
deadquote/s4luca17:
"In some ways, it's my rage that keeps me going."
– Lucas Riggs
deadquote/s4luca18:
"I don't think of death as failure. How would
you even know you'd failed? You'd be dead."
– Lucas Riggs
deadquote/s4luca19:
"I'd always tell myself, 'if I die, at least I'm dying
for something.' Less scary to think of it like that."
– Lucas Riggs
deadquote/s4luca20:
"Lucas Riggs was a man of many words. But the one thing he
never had to say was just how much he loved his friends."
– Arthur Kingsley
deadquote/s4poli01:
"The Nazis I meet do not live for very long."
– Polina Petrova
deadquote/s4poli02:
"The Nazis are looking for Polina Petrova, but
they have no idea who they're about to find."
– Richard Webb
deadquote/s4poli03:
"The moment I saw her on that train, I knew Polina Petrova was
a force to be reckoned with. The Jerrys never stood a chance."
– Lucas Riggs
deadquote/s4poli04:
"Polina genuinely scares the shit outta me
sometimes. Actually, most of the time."
– Wade Jackson
deadquote/s4poli05:
"Every name I cross off my list will be replaced
with another. My work never stops."
– Polina Petrova
deadquote/s4poli06:
"If I waited for men to make decisions, nothing would get done."
– Polina Petrova
deadquote/s4poli07:
"They tried to take everything from me but
forgot my rifle. That was their mistake."
– Polina Petrova
deadquote/s4poli08:
"I do not believe in waiting for justice. My bullets are faster."
– Polina Petrova
deadquote/s4poli09:
"My oldest friend is vengeance."
– Polina Petrova
deadquote/s4poli10:
"That knife taught me how to kill a man. I kept it so I never forget."
– Polina Petrova
deadquote/s4poli11:
"The fear in my enemy's eyes is the closest thing I know to joy."
– Polina Petrova
deadquote/s4poli12:
"They say one can get lost chasing revenge.
But I know exactly where I'm going."
– Polina Petrova
deadquote/s4poli13:
"Polina has more heart than the rest of us.
Which makes her our deadliest member."
– Arthur Kingsley
deadquote/s4poli14:
"The pain of my past doesn't hold me back. It pushes me forward."
– Polina Petrova
deadquote/s4poli15:
"Life is short. But for my enemies, it's shorter."
– Polina Petrova
deadquote/s4poli16:
"Hate is easy. Grief is a battle."
– Polina Petrova
deadquote/s4poli17:
"Staying silent is not a weakness. But inaction is."
– Polina Petrova
deadquote/s4poli18:
"Killing is no cure for sadness. But it lets me pretend
for a moment that the sadness is gone."
– Polina Petrova
deadquote/s4poli19:
"I prefer to work on my own... with one notable exception."
– Polina Petrova
deadquote/s4poli20:
"Nothing I do will give me my life back. But I can take
theirs away and we can both know emptiness."
– Polina Petrova
deadquote/s4wade01:
"I felt the most grounded when I was in the sky."
– Wade Jackson
deadquote/s4wade02:
"Doing things quietly was never my thing.
If I’m fighting, it’s gonna get noisy."
– Wade Jackson
deadquote/s4wade03:
"In the movies, they got a stunt man doing all the
death-defying feats. Me, I do my own stunts."
– Wade Jackson
deadquote/s4wade04:
"My rules of engagement are simple:
If the bad guys want it, they can’t have it."
– Wade Jackson
deadquote/s4wade05:
"When death is breathing down your neck,
you find out who you are real quick."
– Wade Jackson
deadquote/s4wade06:
"Flying with Wade was mildly terrifying. But he was a
great pilot, and deep down I sorta knew that despite
the danger I was in good hands."
– Mateo Hernandez
deadquote/s4wade07:
"If I had to do my life over again, I'd probably change
some things. Kinda the point of a do-over, isn't it?"
– Wade Jackson
deadquote/s4wade08:
"The days that break you are the days that make you." 
– Wade Jackson
deadquote/s4wade09:
"I used to never want to work with others.
Turns out I just hadn't met the right team."
– Wade Jackson
deadquote/s4wade10:
"I'll never stop flying. If I stop flying it means
I'm dead, and that'll be the fucking worst."
– Wade Jackson
deadquote/s4wade11:
"Wade Jackson is gonna do what Wade Jackson is gonna do."
– Lucas Riggs
deadquote/s4wade12:
"Those who count Wade Jackson out are in for a hell of a surprise."
– Arthur Kingsley
deadquote/s4wade13:
"When Wade said, 'hang on back there,' it was 
a warning that he was about to show off."
– Polina Petrova
deadquote/s4wade14:
"Jackson was a real pain in the ass, but damn 
were we glad he was flying on our side."
– John Miller
deadquote/s4wade15:
"I always gave orders knowing Jackson would break them. 
I couldn't say it then, but I didn't mind – he always
got the job done, didn't he?"
– Sam Davis
deadquote/s4wade16:
"There was always a chance we wouldn't come back. And I was okay
with that, so long as we took the bastards down with us."
– Wade Jackson
deadquote/s4wade17:
"Interesting people always had a way of finding me, whether I was
looking for them or not. I'm just a really likeable guy, I guess."
– Wade Jackson
deadquote/s4wade18:
"Looking at yourself through someone else’s eyes doesn’t just change 
how you see yourself. It changes how you see everyone else, too."
– Wade Jackson
deadquote/s4wade19:
"Some say I'm cocky. I say, it's just obvious to
everyone I can get the job done."
– Wade Jackson
deadquote/s4wade20:
"Flying isn't second nature to me it -- it's my first." 
– Wade Jackson

script/seeker_death_easy:
You were killed by a Seeker.
Watch out for the Seeker danger indicator.
script/stealth_crouch_hint: Standing makes you more visible to enemies. Crouch to reduce visibility.
script/stealth_disengage_hint: If you are overwhelmed by enemies, you can hide to disengage.
script/stealth_gunshot_hint: Firing non-suppressed weapons will alert nearby enemies.
script/stealth_proximity_speed_hint: Enemies in close proximity can hear your footsteps. Move slowly to avoid detection.
script/suicide_bomber_plr_obit: You were killed by a suicide bomber. Aim for the head.
script/tracking_grenade_death: You were killed by a grenade.
script/use_the_panzerfaust_antitank: Use the Panzerfaust anti-tank weapons behind the bunker to destroy the tanks.
script/weap_discharge_fail: Negligent discharge of a firearm will not be tolerated.
script_platform/ac130_hint_toggle_therma:
Press ^3[{+activate}]^7 to toggle thermal vision
between white hot and black hot.
script_platform/ac130_hint_zoom_and_fire: Press ^3[{+speed}]^7 to control zoom and press ^3[{+attack}]^7 to fire.
script_platform/dog_death_do_nothing: Melee the dog right when it bites to grab its throat. ^3( [{+melee}] )^7
script_platform/dog_death_too_late: Melee the dog before it bites to grab its throat. ^3( [{+melee}] )^7
script_platform/dog_death_too_soon: Wait for the dog to bite to grab its throat. ^3( [{+melee}] )^7
script_platform/hint_adsstop: Press^3 &&1 ^7a second time to stop aiming down the sight.
script_platform/hint_crouchtogglefrom: Press^3 &&1 ^7a second time to stand up from crouch.
script_platform/hint_firstobjective: Look at your first objective and press USE^3 &&1 ^7to retrieve.
script_platform/hint_firstweaponkey: Press^3 &&1 ^7to switch to your first weapon.
script_platform/hint_get_detonator: Hold down^3 &&1 ^7to pick up the detonator.
script_platform/hint_holddownadskey: Hold down^3 &&1 ^7to aim down the sight.
script_platform/hint_leanleftkey: Hold down^3 &&1 ^7to lean to the left.
script_platform/hint_leanoutwindow: Press USE^3 &&1 ^7to lean out of the window.
script_platform/hint_leanrightkey: Hold down^3 &&1 ^7to lean to the right.
script_platform/hint_movebackward: Press your Move Back key^3 &&1 ^7to move backwards.
script_platform/hint_moveforward: Press your Move Forward key^3 &&1 ^7to move forward.
script_platform/hint_pickupweaponkey: To pickup a weapon, look at it and press USE^3 &&1].
script_platform/hint_plantexplosives: Look at the explosives spot and press ^3[{+activate}]^7 to plant the explosives.
script_platform/hint_raisefrompronetocro: Press^3 &&1 ^7to switch from crouch from prone.
script_platform/hint_secondweaponkey: Press^3 &&1 ^7to switch to your second weapon.
script_platform/hint_standfromcrouchkey: Double tap^3 &&1 ^7to stand up from crouch.
script_platform/hint_standletgopronekey: Let go of^3 &&1 ^7to come out of prone.
script_platform/hint_standletgosecondkey: If this makes you go prone, double tap^3 &&1].
script_platform/hint_strafeleft: Press your Move Left key^3 &&1 ^7to move left.
script_platform/hint_straferight: Press your Move Right key^3 &&1 ^7to move right.
script_platform/hint_swapweaponskey: HOLD USE^3 &&1 ^7to swap your current weapon for another that you are looking at.
script_platform/hint_switchtosecondweapo: You now have two weapons. Press^3 &&1 ^7to switch to your second weapon.
script_platform/launchfacility_a_hint_pl: To plant C4, approach the glowing objective marker and press ^3[{+activate}]^7.
script_platform/launchfacility_a_hint_sm: Throw smoke ^3[{+smoke}]^7 to safely approach the enemy vehicle.
script_platform/spool_minigun: Hold ^3[{+speed_throw}]^7 to spool up the minigun.
script_platform/steer_drone: Use the mouse to steer the missile.
